  WHY: The code is correct and fails closed, so this does not fail at runtime. An operator who sees `outcome=stale ... detail=api_error` after the integration branch synced during the reads finds no documented cause and may look for an API outage that did not happen. glm also notes that the header's fail-open list at lines 54-55 can be read as covering this unreadable-tip path, which actually fails closed. Both reviewers rated it NIT, mapped here to low.

Workflow runs therefore always use the default-true setting at `scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:358`. The reviewer rated this MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash explicitly declined to report it, because the issue states "Entry point: unchanged" and `files_touched` excludes `.github/workflows/ci.yml`.

  expected_change_site: `scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh`, the sync-only API reads.
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]

The reviewer rated this NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash explicitly declined to report it as an accepted won't-fix, because the issue's own pagination requirement contradicts the cap and the cost is documented.
